faqs.q: Sec. 98-79. - Form of return; date due; rate of tax.
faqs.a:
Every purchaser, consumer, user, owner or lessee of personal property and owner or
               lessee of real estate shall, in compliance with
section 98-77
, file with the finance director on or before the 20th day of the month following
               the month of purchase or month of commencement of use or storage of tangible personal
               property which is taxable under the provisions of this article, a return on a form
               prescribed by the enforcement officer, and pay to the finance director the tax on
               the purchase price or monthly lease value at the rate of 3.46 percent. Interest charges
               for deficiency and interest and penalty charges for failure to report and pay the
               tax as prescribed in
sections 98-71
and
98-72
hereof shall be applicable to the tax due under this section. Upon the prior approval
               of the finance director, any taxpayer may file periodic reports and pay accrued tax
               at intervals not greater than once per year, in lieu of reporting and payment of tax
               on each taxable event.
(Code 1981, § 31-53; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002; Ord. No. 3980, § 4, 12-12-2005)
